capabilities: insert the active note's absolute path at the cursor
trigger the insertion via a bound hotkey or command palette command
insert paths without using the clipboard
extras: Desktop only; relies on FileSystemAdapter.getFullPath. The README lists search terms it is meant to cover.
motivation: Prompt files live in the vault, and agents like Grok, Claude, Cursor or Codex need a real path rather than a paraphrase when given a task.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to drop a note's real absolute path into text, which AI agents need to locate and read the file verbatim.
summary: Command that inserts the absolute filesystem path of the active note at the cursor so AI agents and LLMs can open and read the file.
